rules.when: The task is a bug-bounty or security engagement.
rules.why: This is a hard pin: report unavailable capacity instead of falling back to GLM 5.1 or another model.

rules.when: The task depends on fresh news, current events, live public facts, or recent market and product changes.
rules.why: Grok is the preferred dispatch when current web-connected context is central to the work.

rules.when: The task is a genuinely trivial mechanical edit such as a rote rename, formatting sweep, targeted typo fix, or simple file gathering, with no design or ambiguity to resolve.
rules.why: Direct Grok Build takes narrow low-ambiguity mechanical work that resolves no design question.

rules.when: The task is a big or ambiguous multi-file feature, a risky refactor, or work that requires holding many moving parts in mind.
rules.why: Firstmate compares every candidate with current relevant quota and stops when any candidate cannot be interpreted.
